book_title: 小蓝本高中卷9 不等式的解题与技巧
stem_md: 设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 都是正实数, 求证: $$\frac{1}{x_{1}} + \frac{1}{x_{2}} + \cdots + \frac{1}{x_{n}} \geqslant 2\left(\frac{1}{x_{1} + x_{2}} + \frac{1}{x_{2} + x_{3}} + \cdots + \frac{1}{x_{n-1} + x_{n}} + \frac{1}{x_{n} + x_{1}}\right).$$
original_text_md: 设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 都是正实数, 求证: $$\frac{1}{x_{1}} + \frac{1}{x_{2}} + \cdots + \frac{1}{x_{n}} \geqslant 2\left(\frac{1}{x_{1} + x_{2}} + \frac{1}{x_{2} + x_{3}} + \cdots + \frac{1}{x_{n-1} + x_{n}} + \frac{1}{x_{n} + x_{1}}\right).$$
